concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-standard-integration-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 Standard Web Drop-in Sessions guide for Checkout API v72+/Web v6.30.0+, server/client/webhook integration, redirects and authorization-outcome handling; session/client status is not capture or settlement proof.
warnings: The guide's /sessions field table marks countryCode and shopperEmail with required icons while its descriptions provide a locale fallback and call email strongly recommended (raw lines 473–475); retain the tension rather than claiming a settled API schema.
This guide covers Standard online-payment Web Drop-in; do not route it as Payout Service or infer a merchant-of-record/legal seller model.
